name: SambaNova
h1_tail: Funding Rounds, Share Prices and Ownership
description: SambaNova is privately held and has no ticker. Review the price of each funding round, the investors, funds and SPVs that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: SambaNova Systems is a privately held AI chip company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the prices at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $1 billion first close of a Series F round announced on July 8, 2026, valued the company at $11 billion.

Founded in 2017 and based in San Jose, California, SambaNova designs processors for running trained AI models and offers them in its own computer systems and through a cloud service. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions, frequently through special purpose vehicles, and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
figs: Special purpose vehicles with SEC filings naming SambaNova
table_note: Valuations are as reported at the time of each round. SambaNova did not disclose a valuation for its Series E, and the Series F figures reflect that round's first close.
round_notes: General Atlantic led the Series F. SambaNova has not announced a second close of the round.

A round price reflects what investors paid for the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: General Atlantic led the Series F, with significant investments from Seligman Ventures, T. Rowe Price and Capital Group. Vista Equity Partners and Cambium Capital led the Series E, with participation from Intel Capital, and SoftBank Vision Fund 2 led the Series D. Other investors include BlackRock, Qatar Investment Authority, Battery Ventures, GV, Temasek and Walden International.
spv_sentence: Since 2024, three special purpose vehicles formed to invest in SambaNova have filed with the SEC, one of them in 2026.
funds: Mutual funds and other SEC-registered funds managed by BlackRock and Columbia Threadneedle Investments reported SambaNova holdings in filings for periods in 2026.
sources: Sources: SambaNova's announcements of its Series F first close, Series E and Series D; reports by TechCrunch (July 2026 and April 2021) and Reuters (February 2026); and SEC Form D and Form N-PORT filings.
